    Reading the map

    Bushes are food and plots are gardens; the white ring and the berries or rows show how much is left. Hatched ground is danger. Stepping stones are fords across the river. Each creature has its own shape and colour. The small sign beside it is what it is doing: . White lines are one creature telling another something. Boxes mark what the selected creature knows; dashed boxes are things it was told and has not checked.

    Lab core with first visual slice. Trials, graphs and saving are not built yet.
